title: Ideogram 3 Image Generation Prompt Schema
description: Schema for validating Ideogram 3 image generation prompts produced by this skill.

prompt.description: Image description following the weighted structure: Image Summary first, then details. The first sentence carries the most weight. Effective limit ~150-160 words / ~200 tokens. Content beyond this may be deprioritized.

negative_prompt.description: Comma-separated list of elements to exclude. Be precise without excessive detail. Main prompt always takes priority over negative prompts. NOTE: Cannot be used when character_reference is active.

aspect_ratio.description: Frame aspect ratio. 16:9 for widescreen storyboards. 2:3 for character portraits. 1:1 for social. 9:16 for vertical/mobile. 21:9 for cinematic ultra-wide.

resolution.description: Resolved output dimensions based on aspect_ratio. Not a direct parameter — determined by ratio selection.

magic_prompt.description: AI-powered prompt expansion. 'auto'=AI decides based on prompt length. 'on'=always expand all 4 images. 'off'=use exact prompt without modification. Set to 'off' for precision work, text rendering, or brand-critical images.

render_speed.description: Generation quality. 'quality' mode improves text rendering accuracy. Always use 'quality' when the image contains text.

style_type.description: Artistic style preset. Use to quickly set an overall aesthetic direction. Combined with prompt details for fine-tuning.

color_palette.description: Mood and tone control preset. Influences overall color grading. NOTE: Cannot be used when character_reference is active.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. Use the same seed to maintain consistency across variations. NOTE: Cannot be used when character_reference is active.

style_reference.description: Style reference configuration for maintaining visual consistency. Upload 1-3 images to define aesthetic direction. NOTE: Disabled when character_reference is active.

images.description: URLs or paths to 1-3 style reference images. Images sharing similar look/mood/composition produce unified style. Diverse images produce creative blends.

style_code.description: Saved style configuration code from a previous successful generation. 4.3 billion possible combinations.

character_reference.description: Character reference for maintaining identity across generations. When active, negative_prompt, color_palette, seed, and style_reference are DISABLED.

reference_images.description: URLs or paths to character reference images.

rendering_style.description: 'auto'=AI determines optimal. 'realistic'=lifelike photography with natural colors. 'fiction'=artistic interpretation with stylized elements.

text_rendering.description: Structured text rendering metadata. Supplements the prompt — the prompt MUST also contain the quoted text. This object is for pipeline tracking and validation.

text_content.description: The exact text to be rendered in the image. Must match the quoted text in the prompt.

word_count.description: Number of words in the rendered text. 3-5 = high reliability, 6-10 = good, 10+ = verify output.

font_style.description: Descriptive font style (e.g., 'bold sans-serif', 'elegant serif', 'hand-drawn script').

text_color.description: Specified color of the text (e.g., 'white', 'gold', 'neon pink').

background_contrast.description: Background against which text appears (e.g., 'dark wall', 'white paper', 'transparent glass').

composition.description: Structured composition data. Supplements the prompt with shot framing details from the source shot record.

focal_length.description: Lens focal length hint (e.g., '85mm portrait lens', '24mm wide angle', '200mm telephoto').

depth_of_field.description: Depth of field preference. 'shallow' = strong bokeh background, 'deep' = everything in focus.

metadata.description: Pipeline tracking metadata. Not sent to Ideogram API — used for internal tracking and continuity management.

asset_id.description: Asset identifier (character sheet, location concept, prop, storyboard frame).

asset_type.description: Type of production asset being generated.

skill_version.description: SKILL version that generated this prompt.

intended_pipeline.description: If this image will feed into a video generation pipeline, note the target model (e.g., 'wan-v2.5', 'luma-ray3').
